## Accessibility Checklist

- [ ] All interactive elements are keyboard accessible
- [ ] Focus order follows logical reading order
- [ ] Images have appropriate `alt` text or `aria-hidden="true"`
- [ ] Form inputs have associated labels
- [ ] Error messages use `role="alert"`
- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 body text, 3:1 large text)
- [ ] No new accessibility warnings from `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y`
- [ ] Tested with keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter, Space, Escape)
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected for any animations

## Testing

- [ ] Tested in development environment
- [ ] No console errors or warnings
- [ ] Responsive design verified (mobile, tablet, desktop)
